scripts.dev:api: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs node scripts/wait-for-db.cjs && node scripts/with-local-env.cjs ts-node --project tsconfig.api.json apis/server.ts
scripts.build:api: npm run swagger:gen && tsc -p tsconfig.api.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/apis',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist/apis/apis',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('apis/swagger-spec.json','dist/apis/swagger-spec.json');fs.copyFileSync('apis/swagger-spec.json','dist/apis/apis/swagger-spec.json')"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:page
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:create: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx prisma migrate dev --create-only
scripts.db:push: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx prisma db seed
scripts.swagger:gen: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx prisma generate && node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx ts-node apis/scripts/generate-swagger.ts
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/with-local-env.cjs npx prisma generate && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const target=p.join('node_modules','.prisma');if(!fs.existsSync(target)){const pnpmDir=p.resolve('node_modules/.pnpm');const found=fs.existsSync(pnpmDir)&&fs.readdirSync(pnpmDir).find(d=>d.startsWith('@prisma+client'));const src=found?p.resolve(pnpmDir,found,'node_modules','.prisma'):'';if(src&&fs.existsSync(src)){fs.symlink?fs.symlinkSync(src,target,'junction'):fs.mkdirSync(target,{recursive:true})}}"
